definitions.kappa_crit: the largest kappa_J at which the Proposition 5.5 lower bound would still be positive at this instance; defined only where the logit-space bracket Z >= 0.
definitions.kappa_literal: L_J / mu_J(literal), mu_J(literal)^2 = lambda_min of the Schur complement of J J^T onto span{grad_z H, p - q}; the reading DESIGN.md froze for the measurement suite.
definitions.kappa_restricted: L_J / mu_J(restricted), mu_J(restricted)^2 = lambda_min(Pi J J^T Pi) on range(Pi); the reading the Proposition 5.5 proof consumes in its pullback step.
